'''Saik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] loyal to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she operated at the [[Nightsister Stronghold]] as a gatekeeper.<ref name="SWG:TttNS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Saik was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TttNS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gate Keeper Saik was added to the game with the release of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TttNS" /> introduced in the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
